name: Ecuador (1845–1860)
description: Three equal vertical stripes of white, light blue and white, with seven white five-pointed stars in the blue stripe.
history: Flag of the Marcist period. The revolution of March 1845 restored the white and blue of Guayaquil as a vertical tricolour with three stars; the Cuenca Convention decreed on 6 November 1845 a deeper blue and seven stars for the seven provinces of the republic. Gabriel García Moreno reinstated the yellow, blue and red tricolour on 26 September 1860, now celebrated as Ecuador's Flag Day.
